clock: Minutes after 00:00 CET (UTC+1) on each date

methodology.scope: Primary scheduled rail patterns with published clock times. Replacement buses and coaches are excluded. Sources without public clock times are absent.
methodology.categories: Display classes from timetable facts: night = sleeper services; high speed = 100 km or longer and averaging 120 km/h or with a hop of 50 km or more at 200 km/h or more; long distance = 150 km or longer; otherwise regional.
methodology.passClasses: free = included with no mandatory reservation; reservation = mandatory reservation; excluded = not included; uncertain = unknown or conditional.
methodology.distances: Straight-line distances between consecutive calls; speeds are lower bounds on curving lines.
methodology.firstDate: Trips that began on the evening before the first date are not included on the first date.
